items.title: Jack Sheldon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: Stanley, the guitar player, what’s his name? ... Yeah, Stanley Jordan came on. He had made a living outside doing that. So I wanted to do it.

ctx.x: Someone told me a story about you working on the sidewalk with your case out in front of you?
Yeah. I did that when I was doing the Merv Griffin Show, which I was making good money and everything but Stanley, the guitar player, what’s his name?
